description: Register a typed cross-feature relationship. Two shapes: (1) SAME-PROJECT — kind ∈ surfaced_by|blocks|depends_on|follow_up|supersedes|related, requires to_code; self-links rejected; dedups on (kind,to_code). (2) EXTERNAL (kind:"external") — a cross-project pointer, NOT a same-project link: requires provider; four resolvable sub-shapes — github or forgejo (repo "owner/name" + integer issue), local (repo token + to_code), url (url); plus reserved url-class providers jira|linear|notion|obsidian (parse-valid, require url, NOT resolved in v1). External dedups on (kind=external, provider, repo, issue|to_code|url). Stores on the source feature; query inverse via get_feature_links(direction:"incoming").

derive_expect.description: For github/forgejo, derive open|closed from the owning feature status at validation and push time instead of storing expect.

expect.description: Optional expected state. github/forgejo: open|closed. local: a status token. url-class: recorded, never resolved.

expect_labels.description: Optional labels to add without removing existing labels. Supported by github and forgejo links.

provider.description: Required when kind:"external". Resolvable: github|forgejo|local|url. Reserved url-class (require url, not resolved in v1): jira|linear|notion|obsidian.

push.description: Opt this external link into roadmap_xref_push. Default false.

repo.description: External github/forgejo: "owner/name". External local: workspace-relative repo token.

to_code.description: Same-project: target feature code (required unless kind:"external"). External local: the cited feature code. Need not exist yet.

name: link_features
